message:
Both files compile without TypeScript errors and all 45 existing tests pass. Here's a summary of what was created:

**`src/modules/policy/policy.service.interface.ts`** — Defines:
- `CreateLeavePolicyDto` with fields: `policyName`, `leaveType`, `entitlementDays`, and optional `accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`, `minimumNoticeDays`, `requiresManagerApproval`
- `UpdateLeavePolicyDto` with all fields optional, including `isActive`
- `ILeavePolicyService` interface with all 7 method signatures matching the spec

**`src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts`** — Implements `LeavePolicyService` following the exact same structural pattern as `EmployeeService`:
- Local `ValidationError` class
- Constructor-injected `ILeavePolicyRepository`
- `create()` validates `policyName` (non-empty), `leaveType` (valid enum member), `entitlementDays` (positive number), then sets `isActive: true` before delegating
- `update()` does find-then-apply, returns `null` when policy doesn't exist, validates fields when present
- `deactivate()` does find-then-check-active-then-update: returns `false` when not found, `true` when already inactive, `true` on successful deactivation — never throws
